scope: Theorem 6.1 of the manuscript “The Bogomolov-Pop reconstruction theorem” (preprints/The-Bogomolov-Pop-reconstruction-theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d805627401fffef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The map Θ gives a bijection between the completed curve subfields of K/k and those of L/l. More precisely, for every curve subfield E ⊂ K there is a unique curve subfield P ⊂ L such that Θ( b E) = b P.
